table.name: event_attendance
table.purpose: Junction table linking people (t07) to events/activities (t03); each row records one person's attendance at one event. Evidence: col_001 references t03 records with labels like 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game', 'Food Bank', 'Spring Budget Review'; col_002 references t07 records with person names like 'Randy', 'Emily', 'Tyler'. The many_to_one joins on both sides with no other columns strongly suggest a many-to-many association table (e.g., event sign-ups/attendance for what appears to be a student organization's activity log).

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Reference to an event/activity record in t03 (labels include 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game', 'Food Bank', 'Spring Budget Review'). Airtable-style 'rec...' record ID.

col_002.name: person_id
col_002.description: Reference to a person record in t07 (labels are first names: 'Randy', 'Emily', 'Tyler', 'Keith', 'Elijah'). Airtable-style 'rec...' record ID.

table.name: event_expense_items
table.purpose: Expense/budget line items for club events (food, advertising, parking, gifts, shirts), each linked to an event in t03, tracking budgeted, paid, and remaining amounts and a status. The 'rec...' IDs suggest an Airtable-style export.

col_001.name: expense_item_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record ID for each expense line item.

col_002.name: expense_category
col_002.description: Category of the expense: Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

col_003.name: amount_paid
col_003.description: Amount already paid/spent on this item (0 for unpaid items; median 0). Currency units unknown.

col_004.name: amount_remaining
col_004.description: Remaining unpaid amount; equals budget minus paid in samples (67.81 + 7.19 = 75). Negative values (min -24.25) indicate overpayment/overspend.

col_005.name: amount_budgeted
col_005.description: Total budgeted amount for the item; equals paid + remaining in samples.

col_006.name: status
col_006.description: Workflow status of the expense item: Planning, Open, or Closed.

col_007.name: event_id
col_007.description: Reference to t03.col_001, the event (e.g. 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game', 'Spring Budget Review') this expense belongs to.

table.name: event
table.purpose: Events calendar for a student organization (club): each row is one event (meeting, guest speaker, game outing, community service, social, election, budget review) with its date/time, type, description, location, and planning status. Dates span Sep 2019 – May 2020, i.e. a school year. Referenced by t01 and t02, likely attendance/participation records tied to these events.

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the event row.

col_002.name: event_name
col_002.description: Human-readable event title, e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game'.

col_003.name: event_datetime
col_003.description: Date and time of the event (ISO timestamps, 2019-09-01 to 2020-05-05).

col_004.name: event_type
col_004.description: Event category: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Budget, Election, etc. (8 distinct categories).

col_005.name: description
col_005.description: Free-text description/notes of the event (attendance rules, volunteer details). Null for about half the rows, mainly simple meetings/games.

col_006.name: location
col_006.description: Event location: campus rooms/stadiums or street addresses; 'MU 215' (likely Memorial Union room 215) is the most common. Null for ~14% of rows.

col_007.name: status
col_007.description: Event planning status: Open, Planning, or Closed.

table.name: expense
table.purpose: Club event expense records: each row is an expense/purchase for a student club event, with a description of items bought, the date, the amount spent, the member who incurred it, and the expense category. Dates fall in the Aug–Nov 2019 semester; amounts range from $6 to $295.12, consistent with small club purchases (food, shirts, posters, parking).

col_001.name: expense_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier for each expense row (Airtable-style 'rec' id).

col_002.name: item_description
col_002.description: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g. 'Pizza', 'Posters', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Club shirts', 'Parking').

col_003.name: expense_date
col_003.description: Date of the expense, ranging 2019-08-20 to 2019-11-19 (a fall academic term).

col_004.name: amount
col_004.description: Expense amount in dollars (min 6.00, max 295.12, mean ~65.19).

col_005.name: approved
col_005.description: Boolean flag stored as text; 'true' for all non-null rows (31 of 32). Likely an approval/reimbursement flag, but since only one value is observed, its exact meaning (approved vs. reimbursed vs. submitted) is uncertain.

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to t07 (member/person lookup, e.g. Randy, Emily, Tyler, Keith, Elijah) — the club member who submitted or incurred the expense.

col_007.name: category_id
col_007.description: Reference to t02 (expense-category lookup, e.g. Advertisement, Food, Parking) — the expense category for this row.

table.name: club_member_dues_or_funding_records
table.purpose: Records of money collected or received by a student organization (likely a club): mostly member dues, plus a few one-off funding sources (fundraising, school appropriation, sponsorship). Each row is one payment/receipt on a date, linked to a member (t07).

col_001.name: record_id
col_001.description: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' id).

col_002.name: payment_date
col_002.description: Date the money was received, ranging 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-31 (a fall semester).

col_003.name: amount
col_003.description: Amount in dollars. 50 is the recurring dues amount (33 of 36 rows); 200/1000/3000 are one-off larger amounts matching the non-dues sources.

col_004.name: funding_source
col_004.description: Source of the money: 'Dues' (member dues), 'Fundraising', 'School Appropration' (sic, school appropriation), 'Sponsorship'.

col_005.name: notes
col_005.description: Optional note explaining the funding, e.g. 'Annual funding from Student Government.', 'Secured donations to help pay for speaker gifts.', 'Ad revenue for use on flyers...'. Null for dues rows.

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to a person in t07 (lookup shows first names like Randy, Emily, Tyler). Likely the member who paid dues / the person associated with the record; null on the 3 non-dues rows.

table.name: academic_majors
table.purpose: Catalog of academic majors/degree programs at a university (likely Utah State University, given department names), each mapped to its department and college. Referenced by t07 (likely a student or enrollment table).

col_001.name: major_id
col_001.description: Primary key; Airtable-style record ID (prefixed 'rec'), unique per major.

col_002.name: major_name
col_002.description: Name of the academic major or degree program (e.g., 'History', 'Environmental Engineering'). Unique across rows.

col_003.name: department
col_003.description: Name of the academic department/school administering the major; one department can host multiple majors.

col_004.name: college
col_004.description: Name of the college the major belongs to (e.g., College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, College of Engineering).

table.name: members
table.purpose: Roster of organization/club members with contact info, membership status, shirt size, and links to a location (t08) and another entity (t06).

col_001.name: member_id
col_001.description: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each member row. Referenced by t01, t04, t05.

col_004.name: email
col_004.description: Member's email address, patterned firstname.lastname@lpu.edu (university domain).

col_005.name: membership_status
col_005.description: Membership status/role: Member, Inactive, or officer role (President, Secretary, Treasurer).

col_006.name: shirt_size
col_006.description: T-shirt/apparel size: Small, Medium, Large, X-Large.

col_008.name: zip_code
col_008.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (values 01020–98290), one-to-one with t08.col_001, likely a locations/ZIP lookup table.

table.name: us_locations
table.purpose: US postal locations (cities/towns with their county and state), keyed by a numeric ID; likely a ZIP-code-area or place reference table (referenced one-to-one by t07).

col_001.name: location_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each location row (range 501-99950).

col_002.name: address_type
col_002.description: Type of postal delivery location: 'Standard' (standard city), 'PO Box' (PO-box-only ZIP), 'Unique' (single-organization ZIP).

col_003.name: city
col_003.description: City or town name (e.g. Washington, Houston, New York).

col_004.name: county
col_004.description: County (or county-equivalent such as Borough, Municipio, Census Area) name; ~0.2% null.

col_005.name: state_name
col_005.description: Full US state/territory name (52 distinct incl. DC and Puerto Rico).

col_006.name: state_code
col_006.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation, matching col_005.
